newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - St Barbara upgrades ore reserves.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - St Barbara upgrades ore reserves.

text.p: Gold miner St Barbara Mines Ltd said on Wednesday it had upgraded its reserves and resources estimates for the 1996 year to record levels.
St Barbara produced 118,588 ounces of gold in the 1995/96 year, down from 137,684 ounces in 1994/95 to June 30.
Reserves have risen to 1.34 million contained ounces from 1.30 million, while resources had risen to 2.78 million contained ounces from 2.19 million, the company said.
"These increases are particuarly pleasing as in late 1995 significant discrepancies emerged between reserves, grade control and recovered ounces," it said.
St Barbara said its improved resources and reserve position came at a time when production had shown unbroken growth for the past six months and site cash costs had dropped accordingly.
August site cash costs were A$399 per ounce, and September was again showing an improvement on that.

"With strong cash flows re-emerging, it is intended that expenditures on exploration will again be higher than the preivous year, and with well identified drilling targets in prospect, further success is anticipated," the company said.
